doc.toml:
reflex = 1

description = "Turn the lights in one room on, off, or dim them."
confirm = "Set the lights {power}?"
run = "lights.mts"

[args.state]
ask = "What should the lights do?"
options.on = "Switch on."
options.off = "Switch off."
options.dim = "Lower the brightness without switching off."

[args.power]
ask = "On or off?"
options.on = "On."
was = ["state"]

[args.level]
ask = "How much?"
options.low = "Low."
was = ["state"]

err.message: args.power.was names state, a live argument
state is a former name of both power and level
